resultText:
Coastal vegetation analysis

Optional local CNN estimate. Use imagery matching the installed model and its band order. The GMW 2020 model requires a four-band WorldCover 2020 annual-composite GeoTIFF (B02, B03, B04, B08). Analysis does not change your project, certification or credits.

Image for local analysis (maximum 8 MiB)
Analyze locally

Analysis complete. Review the limitations below.

Research prototype with low validation precision and substantial false positives. This mask cannot verify a project or establish mangrove area reliably.

Predicted mangrove reference extent (GMW 2020) coverage: 87.45%

Area unavailable: no supported metre-based georeferencing. Coverage percentage only.

Model: bluecred-gmw2020-unet-v1. Local inference: 853 ms.

Model validation IoU: 42.7%. This is a dataset score, not accuracy for this uploaded image.

Input: WorldCover 2020 Sentinel-2 annual median GeoTIFF; four bands B02/B03/B04/B08; RGB channels 3/2/1 divided by 10000

Experimental replication of GMW 2020 map-derived mangrove reference labels on a small site-disjoint sample. Not independent field ground truth. Two training sites only; domain shift, residual cloud/composite artefacts and reference-map errors remain. Use matching 2020 annual-composite inputs. No carbon, certification or credit issuance claim. Projected grid area only when metre CRS exists; projection distortion and model uncertainty remain. Input sensor and preprocessing must match training.
